description: Reviewed rule table: executed Probe check category -> candidate ATT&CK techniques. A row applies only when its conditions hold for the finding's recorded facts. Output mappings are always review_status=proposed until a human accepts them. A category with no row, or rows whose conditions fail, is left unmapped with the stated reason.

rules.rationale: The executed check retrieved another identity's resource through a network-reachable HTTP route of the application. ATT&CK T1190 covers exploiting a weakness in an Internet-facing application; whether the route is actually Internet-facing in production is not known to the platform, hence 'proposed' and medium confidence.

unmapped.input_validation.bounds: No ATT&CK technique describes exceeding an application business-rule bound; left unmapped rather than forcing T1190 onto a logic flaw that grants no access.
unmapped.*: No reviewed rule exists for this check category.
